lead: `Core\Config::get` answers nothing for a directive whose value is a list, so writing one into `nvs.toml` to make an example page print a value buys nothing.
body: `[http.client.tls] roots = ["bundled"]` is exactly what this checkout trusts and the page still printed `(nothing)`, because `nvs_config::request`'s `get` returns `None` for a key naming a table or a list rather than a rendering nothing could set back. Run the example against the binary before writing a line into `nvs.toml` for a page's sake — a scalar sibling in the same block, `min_version` here, is what makes a page print a value.
